scope: Ordinary world ticks and real CharacterMovement displacement/collision on a staged level runway and solid wall. Public sprint/dash APIs and AddMovementInput exercise stamina exhaustion/recovery, blocked movement, dash travel, cooldown/held edge, pause and run reset. Isolated QA journals backed up/restored. No legacy combat/route cases, native input, visual or feel evidence.
